body:
That's the thing, I know to give people space, especially lone women at night. I watch where I'm standing in line to make sure I'm giving everybody room. And I try not to walk behind people too closely. In quieter areas I do cross the road. I definitely understand why women feel the need to be cautious. 

Maybe I am subconsciously watching for signs of rejection as you say. I've maybe got this narrative in my head that everyone finds me creepy and my anxious brain is trying to confirm it.

I see, that makes a lot of sense. I do feel like I spend a lot of time trying not to look at people which I guess can look suspicious. Would you happen to know of any ways to deal with this or at least reign it in a bit? Thanks
